readabilityPolicy: Readability revision 3: EXTREMELY SIMPLE chunky low-resolution GAME ICONS, not illustrations. Draw EACH entire panel on a 16 by 18 logical-pixel grid, then enlarge with nearest-neighbor edges. The subject itself is about 12 by 14 big square pixels. Every visible edge follows that coarse grid. ONE recognizable outer silhouette, just 5 to 8 broad flat color regions, at most ONE large identifying feature. The feature is one solid simple shape, never a picture inside a picture. Omit all interior scenes, miniature objects, windows with contents, textures, ornament, speckles, thin lines, fine outlines, highlights, shadows, leaf veins, clock ticks, strings, spokes and scenery. Do not add a leaf base, flower decorations or secondary props to fill space. Animals have solid body patches and a single square eye, no fur or feathers. One or two chunky notches can suggest a feature; no intricate contours. A bigger target board does NOT permit more detail. Leave a clean cyan margin on all sides.
